messages:
tara: Heads up — ACME Prod just flagged that their error dashboard is too noisy and they want a quick win before our next beta. Can we scope a small, gated launch for ‚error-econ quick wins‘?
kevin: what are the asks from ACME specifically? short bullets please.
maria: they want: (1) per-route error rate heatmap, (2) top 10 traces for 5xx by cost bucket, (3) option to suppress noisy infra errors. All as read-only widgets.
kevin: thanks. high level tradeoffs: retention vs cost, sampling vs fidelity, and rollout surface in the console.
josh: for tracing hooks we can add a lightweight filter hook that tags spans with cost_bucket and error_suppressed=true. low perf hit if sample_rate <= 0.15.
lisa: suggested metric names: console.errors.route_5xx_rate, console.errors.top_traces_by_cost, console.errors.suppressed_count. keeps queries simple for dashboards.
sahil: ACME will pay for premium retention, but they need SLAs on the dashboard queries (<500ms) and guaranteed visibility for those top traces.
maria: proposal: ship as a gated feature behind "error-econ" flag. Default sampling 10%, configurable per-customer. Add a toggle in Console to surface suppressed errors.
tara: launch criteria idea: (a) widgets render for 90% of customers in <500ms on our staging dataset, (b) sampling config per-tenant works, (c) docs + one ACME validation run. any objections?
kevin: +1. add a small eval to verify top-trace recall at 10% vs 100% sampling for high-cost routes. Must not regress user-facing signal.
josh: quick config snippet I can add to runtime to test on staging:```yaml
tracing:
  hooks:
    - id: cost-tagging
      apply_when: "status >= 500"
      sample_rate: 0.10
      tags:
        - cost_bucket: auto
        - suppressed: false
```
maria: implementation notes: need backend index change to support cost_bucket facet in the trace store. I'll estimate 3 dev days + 1 day infra config.
sahil: commercial ask: include a one-off ACME rollout for beta with 30d retention. I'll own the contract wording.
tara: ops question — what's the incremental cost risk if we keep sampling at 10% but store full traces for top-10 candidates?
josh: estimate: storing top-10 full traces per error per-minute across 100 tenants ~ 60GB/day. with compression likely ~25GB/day. we can cap to top-5 to halve that.
lisa: dashboard UX: prefer a single compact widget with route heatmap + inline sample traces dropdown. avoids building multiple pages.
maria: rollout plan: canary on staging -> gated on ACME prod account -> broader opt-in in Console. Feature flag + tenant-level sample override.
kevin: prioritization ask: where do we put this on the Q2 roadmap? It's customer driven and low dev cost, so high priority slot for the next sprint if infra can bite the index change.
tara: decision for this thread: green light to schedule sprint work if maria's infra estimate holds and josh signs off on cost cap (top-5). I'll loop in infra. @josh can you confirm cap? :eyes: 
josh: confirmed — I can turn on top-5 storage cap and monitor. Will add alert if daily storage > 40GB.
deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for feature/error-econ-gate on staging at 4789012360 — runbook: /runbook/error-econ-canary.md
tara: thanks all. I'll create the PRD update and add ACME validation checklist. tagging this thread resolved for planning, but keep replies if anything changes. :thumbsup:
